description:
Introducing an outstanding residential development featuring contemporary town homes for sale in Mijas Costa. This exclusive complex is ideally located just minutes from stunning sandy beaches, bustling shopping centres, and convenient transport links, providing the perfect balance of coastal tranquillity and urban accessibility.

These thoughtfully designed 3 and 4-bedroom townhouses feature sleek, modern interiors with clean lines and an abundance of natural light. Each home comes with a private garden and a fully equipped kitchen, combining contemporary style with practical functionality. The interiors are bright and airy, with large windows that invite natural light to flood the space. Residents can take advantage of stunning resort-style amenities, including a sparkling community pool, lush gardens, and a variety of lifestyle facilities such as chill-out zones, a coworking space, a fully equipped gym, and a welcoming social club. The architecture strikes a perfect balance between modern living and nature, creating an ideal setting for both relaxation and active living.

Situated near a sprawling Mediterranean pine forest, these town homes are a mere 10-minute drive to the beach, and just 20 minutes to Marbella and Malaga Airport. With easy access to facilities and services, these homes are less than 1 km from the future Grand Park Costa del Sol, a vast 350,000 m² landscaped paradise featuring artificial lakes, an amphitheatre, climbing walls, a skate park, running tracks, bike paths, and much more. Boasting over 20,000 plants and 2,000 trees, this park is set to become the “green lung” of Mijas Costa, enhancing the privilege of living in this extraordinary area.

Experience the perfect blend of comfort, style, and natural surroundings in this beautifully designed development, set in one of Mijas Costa’s most desirable locations. Call now for more information and to reserve one of these exceptional town homes.
